title: Island Designer action-parameter and error consumers, ACNH 1.0.0

scope.question: Follow FieldLandMakingActionParam and FieldLandMakingError from BCSV getters into native state/action consumers; bound the evidence for validation footprints, local grid writes, output copy, refresh, undo/apply, and ExeFS helper modules.
scope.method: Static analysis of the supplied main.elf, existing decompilation and BCSV-reader indexes, resolved BCSV tables, parsed EventFlow, and the available rtld/subsdk0/sdk ExeFS module images. Direct-call scan covers aligned AArch64 BL instructions throughout main.elf PT_LOAD RX (p_offset=0x888, p_vaddr=0, p_filesz=0x2211a60). No game execution, save mutation, Ghidra project rebuild, Godot work, index edit, or repository publication.
scope.conclusion: The ActionParam table is now joined to a native range validator and a separate temporary 12x12 work-grid/3x3-output path. This proves action-param-driven spatial checks and local scratch-buffer mutation. The trace does not prove that this buffer is the canonical 112x96 island map, that the 3x3 output is committed to world state, or that it is saved/refreshed as persistent terrain. Error counters and generic EventFlow error dispatch are also joined to cliff/river/linecar state functions. Preview/apply/undo and save semantics remain open.

native_call_scan.instruction_filter: 4-byte-aligned AArch64 BL immediate (opcode mask 0xfc000000 == 0x94000000); sign-extended imm26 target.

parser_pointer_evidence.classification: relocated code-pointer sequence; owner and C++ vtable status unresolved

actionparam_parser.interpretation: The 8 early-column getters are reached through the table-row parser. Additional late-column consumers below use cached row views and do not depend on an identified direct call to parser 0x4f2340.

table_view_constructor.behavior: selects a row through global table context at global+0x3d0

validation_function.h_7674c4d6_use: passes cached value into 0x5318e0; value 2 builds coordinate bounds x/z ±1 and iterates the 3x3 area; value 1 takes a single-point check; other values skip this range branch. Column name remains unresolved; behavior supports a validation-footprint-range alias only.

steps: initializes and seeds paired scratch contexts with 0x53e1b0/0x53e2b0
calls 4-byte thunk 0x53e4e0 which branches to 0x53e4f0 with decoded action-param struct

storage_layout.bounds: x,z < 12; layers above 3 fall back to layer 0

local_work_grid.writer_evidence: 0x53ced0 stores one 32-bit value into this local array; 0x53db10 stamps a small pattern into the same array and skips value 5. 0x53d280 reads from it and returns 5 for out-of-range cells. This proves a local work-grid write, not a write to the canonical field map.
local_work_grid.footprint_evidence: 0x53ecd0 constructs layer/type masks and invokes the loop in 0x53f200; 0x53f200 traverses candidate neighbors and updates the local grid through 0x53cb00/0x53db10. 0x53f890 separately records a bounded 3x3 affected-position mask.
local_work_grid.postprocessing: 0x53e7b0 and 0x53e9e0 build/update local derived records and call 0x540610; these routines operate on the nested context passed to the builder. No proven edge from them to the canonical 112x96 world array or save serializer.

output_copy.copy: for each in-bounds coordinate, FUN_00643000 copies 11 payload bytes (offsets 0-4, 6-10, and 12) from source record +0x0c to destination record +0x0c; index=(z-origin_z)*3+(x-origin_x)

local_work_grid.status: proven action-param-driven local spatial processing and patch-like output; actual preview-vs-commit meaning and connection to live world terrain remain unresolved

outer_entry.note: No incoming direct BL or code-pointer-array target was found for 0x540a10 in these bounded artifacts; it may be called through an unrecognized indirect path.

threshold_getter.interpretation: These state-bearing functions use the table value as an error-counter comparison threshold and may increment a state counter. The counter path does not identify the geometric cause of each error.

error_row_dispatch.dispatch: handlers build a generic record and call a dynamic method at record/context +0x18
error_row_dispatch.status: proven generic dynamic error-dispatch data path; exact EventFlow entry resolution and runtime message invocation remain open

landmaking_remove_entries.interpretation: This is toolkit deselection/cleanup. It does not establish terrain removal, rollback, or undo.

eventflow.flow_scope: The four construction-app actions select cGround/cRiver/cCliff or cOff; the two external cOff actions and three Airport cleanup entry points add lifecycle cleanup references, not apply/commit behavior.

other_exefs_modules.interpretation: No literal/export-name evidence indicates these modules contain the missing path. This cannot exclude stripped or indirectly named code. No nnSdk.nss or multimedia.nss image is present in the available extracted module set.

bounded_negative_results: No native path was found from the toolkit action lifecycle 0x2de340/0x2de3f0/0x2de870/0x2de8c0 to the 0x540a10/0x531790 consumer root.
No direct incoming BL or detected code-pointer-array target was found for 0x540a10; its upstream invocation remains unresolved.
The local 12x12 work-grid writes and 3x3 output copy have no proven edge to the canonical 112x96 island map, collision/world refresh, undo snapshot, apply/commit transaction, or save serializer.

The FieldLandMakingActionParam h_75fee4b0 getter 0x4f3dc0 is called from the table parser; the row value RemoveHistory has no proven undo/action caller. Its string registration site 0x4f8930 is not an undo implementation.
Player_ConstructionLicenseApp has no dedicated Apply, Commit, Undo, or Cancel entry; airport LandMakingRemove_* entries select cOff and do not prove map rollback.
open_joins: Input/UI/tool action dispatch into 0x540a10 and whether this is the active Island Designer route.
The semantic identity and table source of the local four-layer 12x12 workspace, and its relation to map preset cells.
Whether 0x54dc70 output is an intermediate preview/result buffer or feeds a live world terrain writer.
The canonical island-cell setter, collision/mesh/navigation refresh after a successful edit, and save layout/member serializer.
Undo/rollback behavior and whether the table token RemoveHistory is consumed by a different runtime path.
Runtime resolution of error-row EventFlowEntryName and the exact handler-to-event-flow edge.
artifact_policy: This is a distinct follow-up report/ledger. It does not modify the index, crosswalk, re-queue, or prior Island Designer report, and it is not committed or pushed.
